posts.author: fumkiller
posts.body: i've be running games off of my laptop for about two year and about 3 days ago all rpgmaker mv games started giving me the same message. typeError: Failed to execute 'getprogramparameter' on 'WebGLRenderingcontext': parameter 1 is not of type 'webGLprogram'. run this on windows 10 and webGL is supported on the laptop

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Hi there,
This forum is for people using RPG Maker to make games. We can't offer much customer support on games other people have already made and published. You could try contacting customer support on the RPG Maker Official site.
However, if it's happening with multiple games, that does rather indicate it's something on your system.
I would suggest you check your drivers for your graphics card, make sure they are drivers made by the company that manufactured the card and not replaced by Microsoft drivers in a Windows update.
